extracted.name: Puerto Rican Canned Corned Beef Stew
extracted.description: Use corned beef in a can and other common pantry items to make this delicious and satisfying stew for a weeknight dinner the whole family will love.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add potato and cook, uncovered, until slightly tender, about 5 minutes. Drain.
Heat oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add drained potatoes, corn, sofrito, and garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, oregano, and bay leaf; cook and stir until flavors combine, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and stir in corned beef; cook until heated through, 6 to 8 minutes.
